route.html: Return — two bookings, same evening. The three sons fly MEX→Madrid→Vienna on Iberia (ZVDHND, dep 19:00); Oliver & Alexandra fly MEX→Frankfurt→Vienna on Lufthansa/Austrian (72PPSU, dep 19:50). Both land Vienna Sat 22 Aug.

open.nights: 1 night · 10→11 Aug · 20 min to CUN airport

open.html: Cecconi's DUMBO: dinner pencilled for Tue 4 Aug 18:30, 5 people. No reservation confirmation on file — call +1 718-650-3900 or book online if it isn't already done.
Polanco: rebooked to run 17→21 Aug. The new confirmation hasn't been filed here — send it over and it goes on the card. Worth checking the cancellation terms of the new reservation.
Cars: Cancún round-trip (7→11 Aug) and Oaxaca (11→17 Aug) are booked. No CDMX car — decided against it, so Teotihuacán on Wed 20 needs a tour or a driver.
Mérida: confirm arrival time with El Palacito Secreto (WhatsApp +52 999 224 4533) — payment is taken through the hotel's own system before arrival, so watch for a card-decline message.

Guest counts: Kobaab, Grana and Casa Badú are all on file for fewer than 5 adults. Hosts have agreed the extra person verbally in each case, but it isn't in the reservations and the extra beds aren't confirmed in writing. Worth getting in writing before arrival.
The Beast: weather-dependent — check the forecast for Tue 4 Aug midday. If it rains they cancel and offer a reschedule or refund, so keep that afternoon flexible.
Update 3 Aug: Cecconi's DUMBO dinner added — Tue 4 Aug 18:30, 55 Water St, Brooklyn, 5 people.

Update 1 Aug: Polanco rebooked to start 17 Aug — the 17 Aug gap is closed and CDMX is now 4 nights. The Beast speedboat booked (Tue 4 Aug 12:00 from Pier 16, 5 adults, order BST-1785575838-e6fd). All price information removed from the tracker.
Update 27 Jul: Mérida booked (El Palacito Secreto, conf 5960376510). NY address + door codes added. Casa Badú 5th bed confirmed. CDMX rental car dropped. Casa Azul + Lucha Libre tickets logged.

Route changes 18 Jul: Chichén overnight, Campeche and Puebla dropped. Yucatán loop: Tulum → Mérida 2 nights (via Cobá, cenotes & Valladolid, Uxmal day trip) → Puerto Morelos (via Chichén Itzá) → CUN. Palenque was dropped earlier for the round-trip loop.
